tasks.title: Conversation #88
tasks.transcript:
Man: Are you interested in going to the book fair this Saturday?
Woman: Absolutely, I love discovering new authors. What time does it start?
Man: It starts at 10 AM and goes until 4 PM. There will be author readings and book signings.
Woman: Sounds perfect. I'll bring my list of favorite authors.
Man: Great! Let's meet up at the entrance at ten.

questions.stem: What event are the speakers planning to attend?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者计划参加什么活动？ 定位原文：Man: Are you interested in going to the book fair this Saturday? 选项分析： A. A music concert 音乐会。对话中未提及音乐或演唱会，所以A选项错误。 B. A book fair 书展。男士明确提到“book fair”，后面又提到作者朗读和签售，所以B选项正确。 C. A food festival 美食节。对话中未提及食物相关活动，所以C选项错误。 D. An art exhibit 艺术展。对话中未提及艺术展览，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the woman plan to bring to the event?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：女士计划带什么东西去活动？ 定位原文：Woman: Sounds perfect. I'll bring my list of favorite authors. 选项分析： A. A camera 相机。对话中未提及相机，所以A选项错误。 B. A list 一份清单。女士明确说要带她喜欢的作者名单，所以B选项正确。 C. A picnic basket 野餐篮。对话中未提及食物或野餐，所以C选项错误。 D. A laptop 笔记本电脑。对话中未提及电脑，所以D选项错误。
